assistant_message.content: On it! Searching for tanning intensifiers with collagen and hyaluronic acid under $20 on Amazon now.

Finding true collagen + hyaluronic acid tanning intensifiers strictly under $20 is a narrow window — most salon-grade options with those specific ingredients sit just above that mark. Here's what I found that comes closest, along with important notes on ingredient transparency:

---

### Options Under or At $20 with Skin-Nourishing Formulas

---

#### 1. [Ed Hardy Coconut Kisses Golden Tanning Lotion — 13.5 oz.](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B009YKK78C)

| Detail | Info |
|---|---|
| **Price** | **$19.55** ($1.45 / fl oz) |
| **Size** | 13.5 fl oz — largest bottle in this list |
| **Rating** | 4.4 out of 5 stars — **#14 Best Seller** in Tanning Oils & Lotions |
| **Key Ingredients** | Tyrosine blend, MelanoBronze, Coconut Oil, Coconut Milk, Cocoa Butter |
| **Type** | Intensifier — no bronzer, no DHA |
| **Note** | Does not list collagen/hyaluronic acid explicitly, but is a highly rated, deeply hydrating intensifier at the best price-per-ounce in this range |

---

#### 2. [Carroten Turbo Tan Intensifier — 5 oz.](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GDR6L5HL) *(Solo option)*

| Detail | Info |
|---|---|
| **Price** | **$18.99** ($3.75 / oz) |
| **Size** | 5 oz spray lotion |
| **Rating** | 4.5 out of 5 stars — **#15 Best Seller** in Tanning Oils & Lotions |
| **Key Ingredients** | Carrot Extract, Shea Butter, Vitamins A & E, Tyrosine, Panthenol, Lycopene |
| **Type** | Pre-tan primer / intensifier spray — no bronzer |
| **Note** | A European formula with excellent reviews; does not contain collagen/hyaluronic acid specifically, but is highly nourishing and one of the top-rated intensifiers on Amazon |

---

### Honest Assessment

After thoroughly searching Amazon, **tanning intensifiers that explicitly contain both collagen and hyaluronic acid** generally start at **$21+** (such as the Devoted Creations Collagenetics at $21 and Brown Sugar Eternal Youth at $23.55 previously recommended). The under-$20 segment tends to use melanin-boosting tyrosine blends and moisturizing oils rather than collagen/hyaluronic acid complexes.

**Best recommendation if collagen + hyaluronic acid are a priority:** The [Devoted Creations Collagenetics at $21](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00CSM4O00) remains the closest match at just $1 over budget, or the [Brown Sugar Eternal Youth at $23.55](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B088ML3H57) for the best overall value with those exact ingredients.
